title.en: Indifference, detachment and lack of interest

usage.en: I don't care (about sth) · I don't care + question word (what/where/if) · "Who cares?" · "See if I care." (defiant)
usage.tr: I don't care (about sth) · I don't care + soru kelimesi (what/where/if) · "Who cares?" · "See if I care." (meydan okuma)

note.en: "I don't care" can sound rude or cold when you are asked for a preference. The polite form is "I don't mind."
note.tr: "I don't care" tercih sorulduğunda kaba/soğuk durabilir. Kibar hâli: "I don't mind."

sentences.en: I don't [care] what people think.
sentences.tr: İnsanların ne düşündüğü umurumda değil.
sentences.de: Mir ist egal, was die Leute denken.

sentences.en: Honestly, I don't really [care] where we eat.
sentences.tr: Açıkçası nerede yediğimiz benim için pek fark etmez.
sentences.de: Ehrlich gesagt ist es mir ziemlich egal, wo wir essen.

meaning.en: something is not a problem for you; either option is fine
meaning.tr: bir şeyin kendisi için sorun olmaması; fark etmemesi
meaning.de: etwas ist kein Problem für einen; beides ist in Ordnung

equivalent.tr: fark etmez, sorun değil, benim için sakıncası yok
equivalent.de: nichts dagegen haben, jemandem ist es gleich

variety.en: AmE + BrE (BrE also: "I'm not bothered", "I'm easy")
variety.tr: AmE + BrE (BrE'de ayrıca: "I'm not bothered", "I'm easy")

usage.en: I don't mind (+ V-ing / if …) · "Do you mind if I…?" → asking permission; the answer "No, go ahead" = of course, please do.
usage.tr: I don't mind (+ V-ing / if …) · "Do you mind if I…?" → izin isteme; cevap "No, go ahead" = tabii, buyur.

sentences.en: "Pizza or sushi?" "I [don't mind] — you pick."
sentences.tr: "Pizza mı suşi mi?" "Fark etmez, sen seç."
sentences.de: „Pizza oder Sushi?“ „Mir ist beides recht – such du aus.“

sentences.en: I [don't mind] waiting.
sentences.tr: Beklemek benim için sorun değil.
sentences.de: Es macht mir nichts aus zu warten.

meaning.de: sich überhaupt nicht für etwas interessieren

equivalent.de: jemandem ist etwas völlig egal, etwas ist jemandem schnuppe

literal.en: it is impossible to care less (it's already zero)
literal.tr: daha az umursamam mümkün değil (zaten sıfır)

variety.en: AmE + BrE. AmE also has the illogical but common "I could care less" (same meaning).
variety.tr: AmE + BrE. AmE'de mantıksız ama yaygın biçim: "I could care less" (aynı anlam).

sentences.en: I [couldn't care less] what he thinks of me.
sentences.tr: Hakkımda ne düşündüğü zerre umurumda değil.
sentences.de: Es ist mir völlig egal, was er von mir hält.

sentences.en: She [couldn't care less] about football.
sentences.tr: Futbol hiç ama hiç umurunda değil.
sentences.de: Fußball ist ihr völlig schnuppe.

expressions.expr: not give a damn / a shit

meaning.en: not to care at all (harsh, defiant)

equivalent.de: jemandem ist etwas scheißegal, auf etwas pfeifen

variety.en: AmE + BrE (BrE also: not give a toss)
variety.tr: AmE + BrE (BrE ayrıca: not give a toss)

usage.en: not give a damn/shit (about sth/sb). The positive can be praise: "He actually gives a damn." = he really cares.
usage.tr: not give a damn/shit (about sth/sb). Olumlusu övgü olabilir: "He actually gives a damn." = gerçekten önemsiyor.

sentences.en: I don't [give a damn] about his opinion.
sentences.tr: Onun fikri zerre umurumda değil.
sentences.de: Seine Meinung ist mir schnurzegal.

sentences.en: He doesn't [give a shit] about anyone but himself.
sentences.tr: Kendisinden başka kimseyi sallamıyor.
sentences.de: Außer ihm selbst ist ihm jeder scheißegal.

meaning.en: Whatever: to cut off an argument dismissively · Meh: "so-so", no enthusiasm
meaning.tr: Whatever: tartışmayı umursamazca kesmek · Meh: "eh işte", heyecan duymamak
meaning.de: Whatever: einen Streit abweisend beenden · Meh: „geht so“, ohne Begeisterung

equivalent.tr: Her neyse. / Aman, boş ver. · Eh. / İdare eder.
equivalent.de: Wie auch immer. / Mir doch egal. · Na ja. / Geht so.

register.tr: gündelik (Whatever tek başına saygısız, pasif-agresif durabilir)

usage.en: "Whatever." (one-word answer) · "Whatever you want." (neutral: as you like) · "meh" as exclamation or adjective: "It was pretty meh."
usage.tr: "Whatever." (tek kelimelik cevap) · "Whatever you want." (nötr: nasıl istersen) · "meh" ünlem ya da sıfat: "It was pretty meh."

sentences.en: "You never listen to me!" "[Whatever]."
sentences.tr: "Beni hiç dinlemiyorsun!" "Aman, her neyse."
sentences.de: „Du hörst mir nie zu!“ „Wie auch immer.“

sentences.en: "How was the movie?" "[Meh]. It was okay."
sentences.tr: "Film nasıldı?" "Eh. Fena değildi."
sentences.de: „Wie war der Film?“ „Na ja. Ging so.“

meaning.en: to have no desire or energy to do something
meaning.tr: bir şeyi yapacak hevesi/enerjisi olmamak, üşenmek
meaning.de: keine Lust oder Energie haben, etwas zu tun

equivalent.de: keine Lust haben, keinen Bock haben, zu faul sein

literal.en: cannot be put to the trouble

register.en: informal (the short form "can't be arsed" is vulgar)

variety.en: BrE. AmE equivalent: "I don't feel like it." ("I can't be bothered" is understood but less common.)
variety.tr: BrE. AmE'de karşılığı: "I don't feel like it." / "I can't be bothered" anlaşılır ama seyrek.

usage.en: can't be bothered (to + verb / with sth)
usage.tr: can't be bothered (to + fiil / with sth)

sentences.en: I [can't be bothered] to cook tonight — let's just order something.
sentences.tr: Bu akşam yemek yapmaya üşeniyorum, bir şeyler söyleyelim.
sentences.de: Ich habe heute Abend keine Lust zu kochen – bestellen wir einfach etwas.

sentences.en: I was going to go to the gym, but I really [can't be bothered].
sentences.tr: Spora gidecektim ama hiç içimden gelmiyor.
sentences.de: Ich wollte ins Fitnessstudio, aber ich kann mich echt nicht aufraffen.

meaning.en: (1) be over sb: no longer to have feelings for them (2) be over it: to have recovered, or to be tired of it and no longer interested
meaning.tr: (1) be over sb: artık ona karşı bir şey hissetmemek (2) be over it: atlatmış olmak ya da artık bıkmış, ilgilenmiyor olmak
meaning.de: (1) be over sb: keine Gefühle mehr für jemanden haben (2) be over it: darüber hinweg sein, oder es leid sein und kein Interesse mehr haben

equivalent.tr: atlatmış olmak, aşmış olmak; bıkmış, sıkılmış olmak
equivalent.de: über jemanden hinweg sein; etwas satthaben

literal.en: to have crossed to the other side of something
literal.tr: bir şeyin öbür tarafına geçmiş olmak

usage.en: be over sb/sth → result (state). get over sb/sth → process (see Category 13). "I'm so over it." = I can't stand it any more.
usage.tr: be over sb/sth → sonuç (durum). get over sb/sth → süreç (bkz. Kategori 13). "I'm so over it." = artık hiç çekemiyorum.

sentences.en: Don't worry, I'm totally [over him].
sentences.tr: Merak etme, onu tamamen unuttum.
sentences.de: Keine Sorge, ich bin komplett über ihn hinweg.

sentences.en: I'm so [over this] drama.
sentences.tr: Bu dramadan gına geldi artık.
sentences.de: Ich habe dieses Drama so satt.

meaning.en: to stop paying attention; to drift off
meaning.de: nicht mehr aufpassen; mit den Gedanken abschweifen

equivalent.de: abschalten, mit den Gedanken woanders sein, vor sich hin träumen

literal.en: to go out of the zone / out into space

usage.en: zone/space out (intransitive, involuntary). tune sb/sth out (transitive, deliberately not listening). spaced out = dazed, absent.
usage.tr: zone/space out (geçişsiz, istemsiz). tune sb/sth out (geçişli, bilerek kulak tıkamak). spaced out = dalgın, uyuşuk.

sentences.en: Sorry, I [zoned out] for a second — what did you say?
sentences.tr: Pardon, bir an dalmışım, ne dedin?
sentences.de: Entschuldige, ich war kurz mit den Gedanken woanders – was hast du gesagt?

sentences.en: I just [tune him out] when he starts complaining.
sentences.tr: Şikâyet etmeye başlayınca onu dinlemeyi bırakıyorum.
sentences.de: Ich schalte einfach ab, wenn er anfängt zu jammern.

expressions.expr: not be one's thing / not be into

meaning.en: something is outside a person's interests
meaning.tr: bir şeyin kişinin ilgi alanına girmemesi
meaning.de: etwas liegt außerhalb der Interessen einer Person

equivalent.tr: bana göre değil, benlik değil, pek sarmıyor
equivalent.de: nicht jemandes Ding sein, nichts für jemanden sein

variety.en: AmE + BrE (BrE also: "not my cup of tea")
variety.tr: AmE + BrE (BrE ayrıca: "not my cup of tea")

usage.en: sth is not (really) my thing · I'm not (that) into sth. A polite way to decline.
usage.tr: sth is not (really) my thing · I'm not (that) into sth. Kibar bir reddetme yolu.

sentences.en: Clubbing's not really [my thing].
sentences.tr: Gece kulübü pek bana göre değil.
sentences.de: In Clubs gehen ist nicht so mein Ding.

sentences.en: I'm just not that [into] horror movies.
sentences.tr: Korku filmleri beni pek sarmıyor.
sentences.de: Ich stehe einfach nicht so auf Horrorfilme.

expressions.expr: shrug it off / brush it off

meaning.en: to treat something as unimportant; not to dwell on it
meaning.de: etwas als unwichtig behandeln; sich nicht damit aufhalten

equivalent.de: etwas mit einem Schulterzucken abtun, etwas an sich abprallen lassen

literal.en: to shrug and throw off / to brush away; off = away from yourself
literal.tr: omuz silkip atmak / fırçalayıp atmak; off = üstünden uzağa

usage.en: shrug/brush sth off (separable). brush sb off = to dismiss someone. laugh it off = to laugh and move on.
usage.tr: shrug/brush sth off (ayrılabilir). brush sb off = birini başından savmak. laugh it off = gülüp geçmek.

sentences.en: He made a rude comment, but I just [shrugged it off].
sentences.tr: Kaba bir laf etti ama takmadım.
sentences.de: Er hat eine unhöfliche Bemerkung gemacht, aber ich habe es einfach an mir abprallen lassen.

sentences.en: You can't just [brush it off] — she's really hurt.
sentences.tr: Öyle geçiştiremezsin, kız gerçekten kırıldı.
sentences.de: Du kannst das nicht einfach abtun – sie ist wirklich verletzt.

meaning.en: to be unable to feel anything (often after shock or exhaustion)
meaning.tr: hiçbir şey hissedememek (çoğu zaman şok ya da tükenmişlik sonrası)
meaning.de: nichts mehr fühlen können (oft nach Schock oder Erschöpfung)

equivalent.de: wie betäubt sein, innerlich taub sein, abgestumpft sein

usage.en: feel/be/go numb · be numb to sth (to have become desensitised to something)
usage.tr: feel/be/go numb · be numb to sth (bir şeye karşı duyarsızlaşmak)

note.en: Different from not caring: it is not a chosen attitude but an emotional shutdown.
note.tr: Umursamazlıktan farklıdır: istemli bir tavır değil, duygusal kapanmadır.

sentences.en: After the breakup I didn't cry. I just [felt numb].
sentences.tr: Ayrılıktan sonra ağlamadım. Sadece hiçbir şey hissetmedim.
sentences.de: Nach der Trennung habe ich nicht geweint. Ich war einfach wie betäubt.

sentences.en: I've heard so much bad news lately that I'm kind of [numb] to it.
sentences.tr: Son zamanlarda o kadar çok kötü haber duydum ki artık duyarsızlaştım.
sentences.de: Ich habe in letzter Zeit so viele schlechte Nachrichten gehört, dass ich schon abgestumpft bin.
